entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Leech life from your target, dealing damage based on Attack Power while healing you. Applies Withered for 8 seconds, reducing your target's outgoing damage by 40% and Crit Chance and Dodge by 20%. If Ex Mortis is active, applies Necrotic Curse for 8 seconds, reducing your target's Magic Resistance by 40%, and Decay for 2 seconds, negating all non lifesteal healing received.

entries.target: A short range status skill that applies to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Summons an army of undead minions to your side (only appears if summoned outside of combat). Applies Deathly Frenzy, increasing your outgoing damage by 150% for 10 seconds. You conjure your darkest magic, applying Ex Mortis which empowers the next skill you use.
notes: Summon is Army of the Dead (Temporary).
Summon cannot be summoned while in combat.
Summon cannot be summoned if a pet is equipped.
